baseline: Exact original source-free w/o Source constructor/checkpoints from d2_ictal_ablation_seed42_v1
development: 65 original validation-fold appearances from47 unique IDs; primary equal-appearance mean, secondary unique-ID mean
features: Original88D Patient-Z and stored FIT-only imputer/scaler unchanged;56 representative curves,16 shared auxiliary duplicates,16 untouched constant-zero columns
weighted_quantile: Stable ascending sort; aggregate exactly equal values; normalize FIT weights; inverse empirical CDF with searchsorted(left). No interpolation/jitter; each FIT patient mass1/P and channel mass1/(P*C)
knots: Deduplicate equal quantile values in float64, store float64 buffers; use same dtype in transform arithmetic. Require at least3 distinct boundaries; otherwise identity/inactive. Registered56x8 theta storage; unused interval parameters masked
slope: 1+0.75*tanh(theta), theta0; mathematical slopes(0.25,1.75), floating endpoint saturation audited
spline: s0*x+sum(ds_k*(relu(x-t_k)-relu(-t_k))) with active-boundary mask; zero anchor; linear tails; no clipping
B1: 56 shared positive linear scales, zero theta, constant columns unchanged
B2: Linear88to2,GELU,Linear2to88 residual before original LayerNorm; output weight/bias zero
backbone: Construct exact original SourceA0(seed).network first; do not reimplement; source V/u/b not registered; jointly train original network
training: Unchanged original trainer; source penalty0; seed42+1009*fold; original reseed/update order; CUDA; AdamW .001/.0001; FIT-only NEZ-positive weighted BCE; gradclip1; max30/min6/patience6
selection: Original validation patient MacroF1, EZF1, earlier epoch; original0.005 grid and threshold ties; own checkpoint/threshold each arm

mechanism.identity: Bypass trained transform only, same trained backbone/checkpoint/threshold
mechanism.permutation: One seed42 permutation of56 whole curve assignments including knots/slopes/masks, same permutation across folds; preserve each duplicate-to-main mapping
mechanism.report: Per-feature/fold slopes, knot/FIT quantiles, transformation magnitude, tail observations; no clinical causality
